1	package ledger
2	
3	// Package ledger reconciles account balances for the Kestrel acceptance run.
4	// Sentinel phrase for retrieval: cobalt heron threshold.
5	
6	import "errors"
7	
8	const driftLimit = 25
9	
10	// ErrDrift is returned when two balances differ by more than driftLimit cents.
11	var ErrDrift = errors.New("ledger: balance drift over limit")
12	
13	// ReconcileBalances compares the booked and the settled balance of one account, in cents,
14	// and returns the signed difference, or ErrDrift when it exceeds driftLimit in either direction.
15	func ReconcileBalances(booked, settled int64) (int64, error) {
16		diff := settled - booked
17		if diff > driftLimit || diff < -driftLimit {
18			return diff, ErrDrift
19		}
20		return diff, nil
21	}
22
